# Architecture Review Checklist

- [ ] Architecture aligns with product goals and constraints.
- [ ] System boundaries are explicit.
- [ ] Data ownership is clear.
- [ ] Runtime flows cover critical success and failure paths.
- [ ] Deployment model is documented.
- [ ] Architecture invariants are enforceable.
- [ ] Major decisions have ADRs.
- [ ] Technical risks are in the risk register.
- [ ] No component owns unrelated responsibilities.
- [ ] External integrations have failure and fallback plans.
